overview: Givethra is a global trust-based humanitarian platform connecting verified people who need help with people who want to help, with full identity verification and transparent case management.
features: Complete profile editor with photo, bio, and personal details
My Profile page with trust score, verification badges, and stats
Full wallet system with Support Credits, purchase history, and receipts
My Requests with 5-tab status tracking for Help Seekers
My Supports tracking for Heroes showing all supported cases
My Cases view with documents, video appeal, and support progress
Real notification center with mark-as-read and delete
Privacy controls including data download and account deletion requests
Security center with KYC status, devices, and active sessions
Google Account Security page replacing Change Password
Settings for language, theme, currency, timezone, and accessibility
